about.what: How many passages of NASA's PSI records and of the papers PSI lists address each fire question, labelled passage by passage by a large language model and checked by this script.
rules: A passage can belong to several questions, or to none.
Each label must quote the words in the passage that justify it; the build checks the quote word for word.

Label what the passage is about, not what it could be relevant to. General combustion science (flame chemistry, soot formation, droplet burning rates) belongs to no question unless it touches the guide.
